description: This file provides functions to fetch a project's name via API endpoints, utilizing axios and utility functions. It includes a primary function 'fetchProjectNameDirect' that attempts to retrieve the project name through an API client or fallback URL, and a deprecated alias 'fetchProjectNameByProjectId'.

methods.name: fetchProjectNameDirect(projectId)
methods.description: Fetches the project name using a project ID, attempting to use a custom API client if available, or falling back to axios with a base URL.

methods.name: fetchProjectNameByProjectId(projectId)
methods.description: Deprecated alias for fetchProjectNameDirect, maintained for backwards compatibility.
